title: Slovakian Braised Meat
description: A hearty Slovakian dish made with tender meat and a rich sauce, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, then set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth and red wine, whisking continuously.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2.5 hours or until the meat is tender.
Stir in the sour cream and serve hot.
